# Kraki for Mac 0.2.93
- **Save and copy chat images**: right-click an image in a chat or in the image viewer and choose **Save Image…** or **Copy Image**. Both are also in the viewer's toolbar. You get the original file under the image's name, so a GIF stays an animated GIF. - **Animated GIFs play** in chats and in the viewer, and the viewer has Play/Pause. A GIF without a loop count loops forever. With Reduce Motion on, a GIF shows its first frame until you play it. - **Sending GIFs**: a GIF you drop, paste or attach is sent as a GIF instead of being turned into a still picture. A GIF that is too large is made smaller and stays animated. While it is being prepared, the image slot shows that it is loading and Send waits; × cancels it. - Devices show a PC running Kraki for Windows by the app's name and version. Once it runs Kraki for Windows 0.1.12 or later, you can update it from this Mac. - Built-in Kraki 0.39.1: every change in [Kraki CLI 0.39.1](https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/releases/tag/v0.39.1).

# Kraki for Mac 0.2.92
- Simplified Chinese: Kraki now follows your system language, or choose one in Settings › General. - Rename any of your devices from Devices; the new name shows on every device. - Dictation lowers other sounds while you speak (the start sound stays at full volume), and the two-row dictation box lines up with the controls next to it. - The message box was reworked: typing a long draft no longer lags, Chinese and other input methods clear and send correctly, Undo/Redo work, quotes and dashes stay plain, and focus stays where you expect. Drop or paste an image to attach it; when it can't be added, Kraki says why. - A message your computer could not take (full disk, or refused by device trust, for example because a clock is off) shows **Not delivered** with the reason; click it to retry or delete. A question the agent withdrew closes at once, and multi-select questions say that several answers can be typed. - Chat: opens at the first unread message, ↓ and Send from deep history reach the newest message, history loads over the direct connection to this Mac while the relay is unreachable, a reply no longer disappears while the connection switches between the two, and Page Up/Down and the arrow keys keep scrolling. - Switching to another GitHub account moves this Mac's built-in Kraki to that account; the old account's sessions are set aside, never shown to the new one. Renaming your GitHub account counts as such a switch: phones have to pair again. - Only one Kraki runs per Mac account; opening a second copy brings the running one forward. The "Computer Key Changed" warning now also shows on the Mac. - Background service: if it never starts, Kraki says "Kraki didn't start on this Mac" instead of showing offline forever; quitting offline keeps it off; it restarts once per update, not on every launch. - Reconnects are faster: a refused connection is retried within seconds, also after sleep or a network change. The menu bar shows "Reconnecting" when Kraki cannot reach the relay, and its status row opens Settings › This Mac. - First setup keeps its window until this Mac is online, offers to connect your phone only on a Mac that runs agents, and shows "Start Using Kraki" once your phone joins. Show Sign-in Window no longer cancels a GitHub sign-in in progress. - Window: below a narrow chat column the Inspector folds away first, then the sidebar, and turning one back on makes room; ⌘N always starts a new session; the sidebar keeps its place when sessions reorder and the connection notice no longer covers the last row. - Session Info: Rename… edits on first open, and Done or Esc saves the title. Changing the model keeps the Thinking level when the new model supports it. Times follow your 12/24-hour setting, and total cost shows a plain "$". - Settings › Reconnect and "Run agents with" ask first while sessions are running on this Mac. - Sign-in errors, agent notices such as "Turn failed" and "Stopped", and table labels are shown in your language; "Relaunch Now" explains when it cannot relaunch. - Built-in Kraki 0.39.0: every change in [Kraki CLI 0.39.0](https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/releases/tag/v0.39.0). After this update, going back to an older Kraki for Mac makes paired apps wait once for about 10–25 minutes.

# Kraki for Mac 0.2.91
- Fixed agents losing access to Documents, Desktop and other protected folders ("Operation not permitted") after an app update. Kraki now restarts its background service when an update replaces it, so Full Disk Access keeps working without restarting Kraki yourself. - Long chat histories fill the window without needing a scroll first, and live action cards refresh when their content changes. - After first setup, Kraki offers to connect your phone right away.
